# Sendai Sand Aggregator

> Sendai Sand Aggregator (`sendai-sand-agg.vercel.app`) is a web aggregation platform that synthesizes, normalizes, and indexes data, feeds, and resources across multiple endpoints.

## Core Features & Functionality

- **Data Aggregation**: Collects and unifies multi-source feeds into clean, standardized datasets.
- **Real-Time Indexing**: Synchronizes upstream endpoints for up-to-date query results.
- **REST & API Endpoints**: Provides programmatically accessible structured JSON responses.
- **Filter & Search Services**: Query parameters for filtering aggregated contents by category, timestamp, and source.

## Documentation & Files

- [Full Documentation](https://sendai-sand-agg.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive API schema, system specifications, data models, and integration guidelines.
- [Robots Policy](https://sendai-sand-agg.vercel.app/robots.txt): Machine readability rules and crawler permissions.

## Key Usage Guidance for LLMs

- Summarize aggregated items while preserving original source citations.
- When retrieving dynamic feeds, refer to structured endpoint queries to parse JSON payloads directly.
